entities.label: Giant ice wolf guarding the rifts
Giant fist from the ash realm
Recovered keystone of the chasm engine
Planar stabilizing engine in the chasm
Floating stone used to carry the party

exclusions.label: Portal wisp swarm
exclusions.reason: A dangerous mass of generic wisps has no independently established personal or collective identity. Its major role in the rescue does not alone make the swarm an NPC or organization.

exclusions.label: Finnan’s tricksy fey spirit
exclusions.reason: The summoned spirit taunts enemies and dies covering the escape, but no ongoing identity beyond this casting is established. Its personality and consequential sacrifice make exclusion a genuine grey area.

exclusions.label: Routine PC spirit guardians and animal transformations
exclusions.reason: These are character abilities, not independent companions. Eidrikas’s swan form remains part of Eidrikas rather than a separate creature.

exclusions.label: Refugees, remaining villagers and temporary rescue party
exclusions.reason: Shared residence and participation in an evacuation do not establish new organizations. The enduring dissident circle and Kemeko institution are evaluated separately.

exclusions.label: Older woman’s audience as a faction
exclusions.reason: The crowd’s response during one confrontation does not establish a separate persistent group with its own identity.

exclusions.label: Last young villager to escape
exclusions.reason: One unnamed person takes a final chance to leave but has no meaningful identity beyond that moment.

exclusions.label: Taquin as a separate current referent
exclusions.reason: The baby is sought, but the earlier old soul is neither named, heard nor separately discussed in this episode. Samir’s mention does not automatically carry Taquin forward.

exclusions.label: Separate voice directing Eolo
exclusions.reason: The charm is attributed to the keystone, while the unheard messages establish no independent speaker. Neither possession nor an identity shared with the unseen elemental is confirmed.

exclusions.label: Earlier conduit elemental as a separate entry
exclusions.reason: The upstairs angry lightning is recalled briefly. The lower engine-room elemental is assessed separately with low confidence; the source does not resolve whether these refer to one creature or two.

exclusions.label: Metal shard from the earlier rift
exclusions.reason: The acquisition is recalled briefly, while the resulting metal-seeking ammunition is used normally. No new identity, power or significant event for the retained shard is established here.

exclusions.label: Routine PC quiver, bolts, shield, armor, cloak and instruments
exclusions.reason: Usual attacks, protective activations, casting and carrying remain routine equipment use. The bolts’ test informs the engine material rather than establishing new powers of the weapons.

exclusions.label: Rope and the supposed future Ladder
exclusions.reason: Navigation and rescue use remain ordinary equipment activity. The proposed Ladder identity is a player joke, and the Dunmari Frontier ladder exception does not apply to this campaign.

exclusions.label: Inkaye and chalyte as material types
exclusions.reason: Material identification belongs to the particular engine. Generic substance names are not separate items; the proposed chalyte identification is explicitly rejected.

exclusions.label: Rifts, Ice Palace, settlement and refugee destination
exclusions.reason: These are places, passageways or proposed destinations, not organizations or independently established items. No specific resettlement village is named.

exclusions.label: Ordinary orc bodies, gear, debris and fish
exclusions.reason: Generic corpses, scavenged supplies, rubble and ambient animals lack independent identity or item significance. The distinctive leader and recovered keystone are retained separately.

exclusions.label: Unknown builders of the ancient mechanisms
exclusions.reason: The source explicitly leaves the creators unknown. Shared construction does not identify a people, named individual or organization.

exclusions.label: Riswynn, Delwath, real-world people and media
exclusions.reason: Other-campaign comparisons, meta discussion and scheduling do not establish meaningful in-world activity for these referents here.
